sourceEvidence.title: Director of Production
sourceEvidence.quote: We are seeking a hands-on Director of Production to lead and scale manufacturing operations for a rapidly growing defense technology company. This leader will own the end-to-end production operation, including assembly, production planning, supply chain, logistics, material flow, inventory, and kitting. 10-15+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, operations, supply chain, or related environments. 5+ years leading manufacturing or production teams.

requirements.quote: Lead day-to-day production and assembly operations across the manufacturing floor. Own production schedules, capacity planning, staffing requirements, throughput, and on-time delivery. Establish scalable production processes capable of supporting prototype, low-rate initial production, and higher-volume manufacturing.

Identify and eliminate manufacturing bottlenecks using Lean manufacturing, root-cause analysis, standard work, and continuous improvement. Build production KPIs around output, schedule attainment, cycle time, first-pass yield, rework, quality, and labor productivity.

sourceEvidence.title: Engineering Manager, Hardware Design
sourceEvidence.quote: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 7+ years of experience in mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, or industrial hardware development. 2+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.
sourceEvidence.degree: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. (preference/requirement with equivalency)

requirements.quote: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of mechanical engineers, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, and career development. Own engineering priorities, resource planning, and execution of mechanical hardware development initiatives. Oversee the design and development of sensing end-of-arm tooling, robotic components, fixtures, and electromechanical systems.

Drive the integration of cameras, 3D sensors, force/torque sensors, tactile sensors, and other sensing technologies into robotic hardware. Lead technical design reviews and establish standards for reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, and system performance.

sourceEvidence.title: Chief Engineer, Manufacturing Excellence
sourceEvidence.quote: Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Systems Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered. Typically, 12 or more years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree, 8 or more years with a master’s degree, or 5 or more years with a PhD.
sourceEvidence.degree: Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Systems Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered.

requirements.quote: Set the technical strategy, standards, and governance for manufacturing processes across internal facilities and contract manufacturers. Lead multi-site efforts to standardize processes, work instructions, control plans, quality checks, performance measures, and continuous improvement practices. Guide design-for-manufacturability and design-for-test reviews.

Provide technical direction for factory readiness, pilot builds, production launches, ramp-up, and ongoing improvement programs. Lead improvements in first-pass yield, throughput, cycle time, manufacturing cost, and defect reduction. Lead resolution of significant manufacturing problems using root-cause analysis, 8D, and other structured problem-solving methods.
